Ceilings: "Flying After 60? Unlock 7 Hidden Airport Perks Seniors Miss!" · 2.1M (senior-perks channel); "A Flight Attendant Taught Me This Luggage Trick | Now I Do It Every Time!" · 1.3M / 11 days (Fly Smart, ≈ 18–50× its normal); "Flight Attendants Wish Seniors Knew These 10 Boarding Secrets" · 892k / 3 wk (The Senior Traveler — a two-month-old older-female-flight-attendant channel, top six 97k–892k: the direct competitor). Lessons: the segment question × FREE × the suppressor × JUST ASK is the apex (entitlement, never exclusivity — the "Only Senior Citizens" form sat at 21k); the flight-attendant role tops the pool; the rules cluster is the deepest by count and the pool's senior-rules skeleton runs on dates that don't exist — honesty is the moat.
- **Channels:**
  - **The Flight Attendant channel (ch. 1, name TBC)** — **face** (former flight attendant, American woman, 50s — late 50s recommended, age an open call; real-or-synthetic and disclosure TBC) / browse / **crew-insider** (new register). Footage: presenter + compiled airport, cabin and luggage b-roll — knowledge only. Spine: seniors × FREE perks, benefits and rights; rule changes, carry-on and TSA; airport, boarding and seat secrets; luggage tricks and theft; the money owed (refunds, vouchers, compensation — the operator's "exposing airline scams and lies" angle); long flights; what crew notice; scams; the safety real reasons. Batch 1 (25): ≈ 75–80% proven clusters / 20–25% new territory; the segment tag on ≈ 35–40% (the Profile D test). Tenure placeholder "25 Years". Shelf lane: layover life (operator's call). Series key "(The Flight Attendant Way)" proposed, open.
- **Niche hard rules:** safety never undermined; no safety myths or crash exploitation; no evasion and no lying to officials (no faked needs); every "new rule" and every "free perk" real, dated and sourced (no senior lanes, free lounges or crew upgrades that don't exist); "scam" defensible, named airlines only on documented fact; crew, gate agents and TSA never the villain, no passenger-shaming; health hedged; persona-claim discipline; brands in text only, no invented official signage (overlay SKILL.md §3).
- **Boundary:** flying and airports; cruise and train travel are a different topic world (a niche question if the audience tab points there).
- **Standing test-default channel:** none. **Generation default when no channel is named:** the Flight Attendant channel (the niche's only channel) — switch to "always ask" the day a second air-travel persona launches (the D × E collab pair in the intake is the network model).
- **Batches:** **batch 1 — 21 titles greenlit 2026-09-24** (operator-edited from the 47-option launch sift and a five-lane follow-up; briefs delivered the same day; 8 of 21 carry the segment tag; "Flying After 70? The NEW 2027 Airport Rules…" scheduled as a January 2027 upload for the year tag; "Haven't Flown in a While? 12 Rule Changes…" briefed as "…You MUST KNOW Before 2027").
